title: NFIRS incidents by hour of alarm
source: ohpah-research Supabase, table nfirs_basicincident, project casmwfxrxlysqizxahcw
query: substring(alarm from 9 for 2) as hour, count(*) where alarm ~ '^[0-9]{12}$'
note: NFIRS alarm field is MMDDYYYYHHMM, so the hour is characters 9-10. NOTHING is excluded: the table holds 18251138 rows and all 18251138 parse to a valid hour. An earlier version of this file claimed 18253517 rows with 2379 excluded; that 18253517 came from pg_stat_user_tables.n_live_tup, which is an ESTIMATE and not a count. Never derive a statistic from n_live_tup.

scope.note: FLORIDA ONLY. A count of distinct states over the whole table returns 1. Do not describe this as a national record.
